description: Twin-engine Douglas transport preserved as a park monument in Bustan-e Besat, south Tehran, where OpenStreetMap records it as the Dakota Airplane Memorial. A DC-3 or C-47 planform with paths leading to it is unmistakable on Esri World Imagery of 21 November 2025. No serial or registration is legible from any source reached, and Iranian press coverage describes it as weathered and neglected.
